crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-10-27 Vietnam time (a scan for 27 Oct, one day after the 26 Oct crawl).
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 97 -> 97 (raw 96.5 -> 96.65; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). One-day step from 26 Oct. CONTENT rises 93 -> 94: two new articles were published on 26 Oct (/articles/custom-living-spaces-melbourne, 2,392 words, and /articles/interior-design-for-property-developers, 2,835 words) after 32 days without one; the corpus grows 243,401 -> 247,309 words, still 13 thin pages and the duplicate Melbourne body. PERFORMANCE holds at 98: 119 of 120 pages under one second; site mean TTFB 325.5 ms (314.4 on 26 Oct), median 262.5 ms (249). One page, /projects/813-clarendon-street, read 1,198 ms in the sequential pass (the only page in the 1-3 s band) but four cache-busted re-reads gave 494, 436, 234 and 233 ms, so it is treated as a transient spike; the ceiling therefore reads 1,455 -> 1,198 ms. CRAWLABILITY holds at 98: 120/120 return 200, 0 orphans; total distinct internal links rise 2,705 -> 2,852 (23.77 per page, the hub now lists 97 articles) and the same 3 articles stay linked only from the hub. ON-PAGE holds at 93: /articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne is still cross-canonical (self canonical 119/120). STRUCTURED DATA holds at 98 (FAQPage 97/97, 409 blocks; six articles went from 5 to 4 blocks, the two new ones add 8).
